summary_en: SATO Corporation to acquire 100% of voting shares in Hiranoya Bussan Co., Ltd. (flexible packaging manufacturer) via stock purchase agreement. Target specializes in soft-pack production for food and consumer goods. Acquisition supports SATO's smart-packaging strategy and integration of auto-identification technology with packaging solutions. Contract signed 2026-06-01; settlement 2026-06-15. Acquisition price confidential. FY3/27 earnings impact immaterial.
title_en: Notice of Stock Acquisition in Hiranoya Bussan Co., Ltd. (Wholly-Owned Subsidiary)
translation_en_brief: SATO Corporation announced on 2026-06-23 that it has entered into a stock purchase agreement to acquire all voting shares of Hiranoya Bussan Co., Ltd., a flexible-packaging manufacturer based in Ōno, Fukuoka Prefecture, and make it a wholly-owned subsidiary. The contract was signed on 2026-06-01 with settlement scheduled for 2026-06-15. Hiranoya Bussan manufactures soft-pack and pouch solutions for food and consumer goods, with integrated production capabilities from plate-making to bagging. The acquisition supports SATO's mid-term strategic vision ("Perfect and Unique Tagging") to drive growth in smart-packaging solutions that combine packaging with digital information and auto-identification technology (2D codes, RFID). The target's manufacturing expertise and customer base complement SATO's auto-identification solutions in an expanding smart-packaging market driven by traceability, consumer digital touchpoints, circular-economy requirements, and the US retail industry's "Sunrise 2027" 2D-code migration. Acquisition price and other financial terms are confidential. The filing notes that FY3/27 earnings impact is immaterial and the transaction does not meet TSE timely-disclosure thresholds but is being voluntarily disclosed as material information to investors.
